pattern: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.
criterion: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.

lesson.title: Verify Customer History Before Claiming Prior Consultations
lesson.when: A customer asks about a previously discussed item or past consultation and the interaction history is not available in verified evidence
lesson.do: Ask the customer directly to clarify their intended item without making specific product claims
lesson.otherwise: State clearly that the past consultation details cannot be confirmed right now
